policy: Preserve exact internal anchors/notes in data; approved reader removes footnote chrome and displays exact source explanations in inconspicuous verse-click About this wording panel. Do not remove internal anchors from bound payload.

notes.exact_text: The selected second object is your horns, not a silently substituted forehead, head or brow. The command is plural, and the if-you-can qualification and Chosen One title are retained without supplying a later personal identification. The body spelling of the mighty-group term requires an independent exact glyph check.

The selected pouring verb is passive and is controlled by the primary pouring entry. His throne/glory/mouth and the final before-him relation are retained; the English does not identify those pronouns by an unprinted personal name. The killing and destruction clauses are both present.

Holding the earth uses the primary seize/hold range, not an additional political office. The selected righteousness-plus-judging expression is not silently rewritten as he judges righteously; its precise construction and the final empty-word relative need further review. Both before-him phrases and the negative no-empty-word are retained.

The selected bracketed childbirth/distress clause is included in meaning rather than silently removed. The text describes the opening, literally mouth, of the womb, not a new medical mechanism. The childbirth comparison follows the actual pain/womb/distress vocabulary; exact attachment of the bracketed doubled birth term remains uncertain.

One looking at another is a provisional interpretation of the unusual repeated ወኒርቁሙ/ለመኒርቁሙ sequence; it is not replaced by a familiar reciprocal phrase in the source. Primary terror, lowering, face and pain senses support the rest. The selected Son of Man is retained without adding an identity.

The blessing, praising and magnifying share a him object, followed by the one who rules all hidden things. No later personal name is supplied for that referent, and holding the earth is kept distinct from the rule-all-hidden-things clause.

The selected wording puts before-him next to his-power in an unusual construction. In his power is provisional, not an adopted added preposition. The Son-of-Man expression and the Most High are both retained without collapsing their printed relations. From the beginning and the chosen recipients remain explicit.

The printed sowing verb is rendered sow, not silently replaced with gather or establish. Assembly has primary association/congregation support; the seed/assembly image is left as the selected metaphor. All the chosen and that day are retained.

The long plural subject is included rather than dropping a group between fall and on-their-faces. Charles printed113 note13 regards the intervening group list as syntactically suspicious; this proposal retains the selected edited sequence without deleting it. Petition/plead/ask-for-mercy are distinct printed verbs, and no unprinted recipient is supplied.

The selected urging/driving verb is controlled by the primary hasten/urge range. Shame fills their faces, and darkness increases; the text is not turned into a new punishment mechanism. Before his face and their faces are separate possessive relations.

The source gives an anonymous plural they-will-hand-over; this proposal does not replace it with a singular named Lord as agent. Exact repayment follows the primary requital sense. His righteous and chosen ones occur at the end of the cross-page unit and are not omitted.

Spectacle and the intoxication metaphor have primary lexical support. The selected wrath predicate and the exact sword phrase require further form/syntax confirmation; rests is provisional, not an adopted reported reading. The righteous/chosen recipients and the rejoicing relation are retained without an added instruction to later readers.

Both selected negative elements in the face/seeing expression are preserved as a single natural English no-longer relation, not treated as a positive. The source does not add an explanation of whether the condemned cease to exist; the statement concerns what the saved will see.

The selected preposition is over/upon them, retained rather than silently replaced with among. Eat, lie down and rise form the printed sequence; no extra drinking verb or resurrection date is inserted. The Son-of-Man title is not supplied with a later personal name.

The selected lowering-of-face expression is nominal and awkward; the proposal does not turn it into an unprinted singular person ceasing to be downcast. Rise-from-earth and put-on-a-garment-of-glory are both retained. The tense/subject attachment of the middle clause needs further review.

The selected possessive suffixes turn to second-person plural your. This shift is retained, not silently harmonized to their. The primary old/worn sense and the two negatives not-grow-old/not-end are retained. The final title remains Lord of Spirits; no claim of new manuscript attestation is made.

The handed-over relation belongs to the punished people, not a new angelic punishment of the angels. A little rest is limited in extent, not pardon or release. Acknowledge their sins follows the selected confession construction and does not insert a claim that the request is granted.

Radiant follows the selected starred light/brightness adjective, controlled by primary499–500, not an unmarked change to blessed. Bless and praise remain separate opening verbs. The repeated Lord titles and their kings/mighty/wealthy/glory/wisdom relations are all included.

The opening your-power/in-every-hidden relation is a provisional construal of the selected order, not an added claim that every mystery is controlled. The repeated generations, forever phrase and both no-number clauses are retained. The precise first predication and the displayed hidden-things inflection need independent review.

The selected know-that construction introduces praise and blessing; should supplies the English relation, not an unprinted claim that they performed it earlier. Lord-of-kings and reigns-over-all-kings remain distinct repeated expressions.

The selected give/grant form is read with future force in this question, as the actual printed115 note24 discusses; it is not replaced in the source with a different tense form. The object of confess is not newly supplied as sins in this verse. Your glory remains second person.

Pursue follows the selected starred active pursuit form; no object is invented for do-not-catch-hold. Both negatives are retained. The completed passing of light and the darkness/dwelling claim remain the speakers own statement, not an added narratorial explanation.

The bracketed repeated did-not-praise clause is retained in English and source, not silently deleted as an editorially diagnosed repetition. The initial starred form is unusual for the expected first-person plural: we did not believe is provisional and must not be treated as a normalized source spelling. Hope in kingdom-scepter and in glory is retained.

The selected final face-taking negative is rendered not-show-partiality provisionally, with the first-person-us element retained. The exact trustworthy expression and the relation of his-face/judgment/us require independent lexical and grammatical control. Toil/distress, not-save and not-find-rest are not omitted to smooth the paragraph.

Perish and counted are distinct source roots despite their similar English context. The primary number/count range supports counted. In righteousness is retained without adding a named book or an account not printed here. The plural speakers remain we/our throughout.

The selected first verb has a them object; the proposal preserves say-to-them rather than silently turning it into they say among themselves. The soul is singular with our suffix. Its wealth/from-it relation and the following withholding negative are not fully resolved. Belly follows the primary internal-organ range; it is not a claim about a mapped physical underworld.

The voice changes to a passive/reflexive driven-away form, controlled by the primary expulsion range. Their faces, his face and among them are not collapsed into a single pronoun relation. The sword dwells among them; the text is not silently rewritten to mean a sword belonging to him or a newly named angel.

The selected decree/order noun is provisional here, and the following his/its-judgment suffix is not silently dropped. The complete list continues across PDF154→155 and ends before LXIV. Both occurrences of Lord of Spirits are retained; the source is not shortened to a chapter heading.

The selected word face/aspect can introduce a further vision; primary1209 has the same expression with an explicit64:1 reference. Hidden things is retained as a separate selected expression rather than inventing a new heavenly location. The narrator remains I.

The selected middle verb has an unusual visible form, provisionally rendered made-hidden-things-enter. It is not silently normalized to revealed or taught from another witness. The repeated children-of-humanity expressions and the purpose to-commit-sin are retained. The exact middle form and its relation to the first-person-looking suffix require source and grammatical review.
